title: Dogs and Other Animals Under Observation
footnotes: Observation Kennels.—Animals admitted to the Kennels under observation for Rabies numbered 203 dogs and 9 cats, as compared with 174 dogs and 2 cats for the preceding year. Of the total number of animals admitted, 190 had bitten people, an increase of 28 over the returns for 1927. 13 dogs died in the Kennels during the year and of this number 11 were rabid, 5 less than last year.
